verdict.reasons: Core conditions are met. The single white-and-blue cylindrical package displays the correct AFP branding, and the required watermark is present. The observed installed lateral is a round black supply line rather than a thin flattened drip tape, which conflicts with the specific evidence instructions; however, this mismatched infrastructure is treated as a technical advisory rather than an automatic rejection since the commercial product family (the package) remains correct and unobscured.

focused_physical_review.reason: The black irrigation line and the gauge assembly are positioned to the right of the white-and-blue AFP package. A broad, uninterrupted soil gap is clearly visible around the complete footprint of the package, including its front, left, right, and back. The irrigation line does not touch, emerge from, or disappear underneath the package. No distinct additional loose uninstalled coil or roll is present outside the required package. No white ribbon, strap, or tape tail is visibly protruding from the sides or base of the carton.
